taxonomic_note: Current Kew accepts Fraxinus albicans; older Texas-ash names are retained as synonyms.
look_here_first: Once you know it is an ash, go to the lower leaflet surface and the samara: Texas ash usually has a glaucous white-reticulate waxy underside, a relatively small seed body, and a wing that is terminal or only slightly decurrent.

best_field_traits: opposite branches and odd-pinnate leaves, usually 5–7 leaflets
lower leaflet surface characteristically glaucous with white-reticulate wax
leaf scar depressed-obovate with shallowly concave/notched upper margin
samara body small, with wing terminal or only slightly decurrent
morphology_keys.leaf_morphology: Usually 5–7 relatively short/broad leaflets; margins entire to distally crenulate/serrate.
morphology_keys.abaxial_surface: Glaucous, often with dense white-reticulate wax overlay.
morphology_keys.leaf_scar: Depressed-obovate, shallowly concave/notched above, sides somewhat flaring.
morphology_keys.fruit: Samara body about 1 cm; wing terminal or only slightly down distal quarter.
morphology_keys.bark: Gray, becoming furrowed with interlocking flattened ridges.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Green ash has a larger samara body and wing extending much farther down it. Mexican ash tends toward 3–5 coarsely serrate leaflets and can produce occasional 3-winged fruits.

field_diagnostics.single_best_trait: On a fruiting female tree, the small ~1 cm samara body with a wing that is terminal or only slightly decurrent is the strongest cue.
fastest_traits: Lower leaflet surface glaucous with dense white-reticulate wax
Samara body about 1 cm; wing only slightly decurrent on distal ~1/4
Leaf scar depressed-obovate with shallow concavity/notch above

look_alikes.distinction: Green ash has a larger >1.5 cm samara body with the wing running farther down the body; its lower leaflet surface is generally non-glaucous.
Mexican ash usually has fewer 3–5(–7) leaflets with coarse sharp distal serration and >1.5 cm samaras whose wings expand gradually from near the base.

unreliable_alone: leaf-scar shape from one old/damaged scar
